quarterly_data.signal: Correction filing (corrected 10-13-2026; reason: change of contract amount and end date) for the custom semiconductor (ASIC) design and development contract with Supergate Co., Ltd. (semiconductor and electronics development, manufacturing and design; no prior same-type contract with ASICLand in the past three years; Supergate's latest revenue KRW 18,298,341,922 on its 2024 financial statements). Contract amount raised from KRW 13,239,673,298 (14.1% of revenue) to KRW 13,450,153,298 (14.3%), and the end date moved from 2026-12-31 to 2027-12-31; in US dollars the amount changes from $9,435,343 to $9,585,343 at the 10-01-2025 Hana Bank first posted base rate of KRW 1,403.20 as of the amended contract date. Contract signed 2025-04-29 (term 2025-04-29 to 2027-12-31); supply region Korea; in-house and outsourced production; down payment / advance: yes; payment within 30 days of invoice; amount ex-VAT; revenue base is ASICLand's 2024 consolidated revenue of KRW 94,058,022,977 (K-IFRS). The company notes the amount and term may change as the design progresses.
